findings.title: Carry-forward ignores implementation compatibility and relabels old values
String false exposes a hidden fixture to the application
Resume mixes changed application code under an unchanged identity
Non-finite dataset input is silently changed during execution
Scoring/rescoring returns success for incomplete or failed evaluation
Rescore CLI shrinks selected denominators and inflates coverage
Headless slash commands lose the configured provider
Malformed input escapes CLI error handling and breaks JSON output
JSON report export omits the redaction applied to other formats
Numeric expected judge repeats are undercounted
Standalone reports use repetition-weighted means instead of default case macro means
Some advertised size caps act after the whole response is read
Smoke testing rejects a changed revision of an existing application
Terminal regression tests inherit capability/color flags and report false failures
Comparison ignores selected work and uses workspace-wide dataset cases as its denominator

feature_gaps.title: Consistent global configuration and scripting options
feature_gaps.detail: **Missing/partial; specified.** Root options do not provide global `--config`, `--json`, `--non-interactive`, or policy selection. Equivalent controls are scattered among commands.

feature_gaps.title: Stable machine-output API
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Successful commands often support JSON; failures, envelope/schema, exit details, and event output are inconsistent. F06/F07/F10 demonstrate the consequences.

feature_gaps.title: Regression policies for CI
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Absolute release gates and compatible run deltas exist. `compare` exits for compatibility/coverage, not a configured degradation in score, latency, or cost. Add predeclared regression tolerances and fail rules.

feature_gaps.title: Complete case-result export
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Report JSON contains summaries and non-passing evidence. There is no general headless export of every passing/failing case and repetition to JSONL/CSV, with explicit content controls.

feature_gaps.title: CI report adapters
feature_gaps.detail: **Missing.** Benchmark-result JUnit/SARIF-style exports are absent. The repository's pytest JUnit files are test evidence, not a user feature.

feature_gaps.title: Named baselines, tags, and searchable run history
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Run IDs, status filters, and a limit exist. Baseline aliases, run tags/notes, metadata search, pagination, and promotion of an approved baseline are missing.

feature_gaps.title: Convenient bounded run controls
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Plans support selection, repeats, concurrency, retries, timeouts, budgets, caches, and quotas. `run` largely requires editing a plan file. Add validated direct overrides and a dry-run that prints the exact frozen scope.

feature_gaps.title: Reproducibility controls and provenance
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Selection/bootstrap seeds and frozen configuration exist. The run CLI does not expose the engine's `run_seed`; local source/dependency/commit provenance is incomplete, as F04 shows.

feature_gaps.title: Release gates in conversation drafts
feature_gaps.detail: **Missing; documented limitation.** Gates can be authored in executable plans but not declared through session draft choices/patches.

feature_gaps.title: Retry only failed application work
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Engine transient retries and unfinished judge rescoring exist. There is no convenient headless command creating a bounded child run from failed/selected application cases with parent lineage.

feature_gaps.title: Headless run supervision
feature_gaps.detail: **Deferred/partial.** Status exists; live pause/stop controls belong to the owning terminal/session. Detached execution and durable external pause/resume/cancel requests are absent.

feature_gaps.title: Configuration management
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Config files, setup, and doctor exist. There is no `config show/validate/set` workflow showing effective values and source precedence with secrets redacted, or named provider profiles.

feature_gaps.title: Structured progress and durable logs
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Terminal progress and persisted run events exist. Scripts lack a consistent JSONL event stream, log-file selection, verbosity/quiet controls, and documented noninteractive logging contract.

feature_gaps.title: Warmup and measurement phases
feature_gaps.detail: **Missing; performance extension.** No bounded warmup count or exclusion phase before latency sampling. Warmup effects and spend need to be accounted explicitly.

feature_gaps.title: Richer performance statistics
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Successful final-attempt p50/p95 and failure counts exist. User-facing throughput, p99, dispersion, retry-inclusive elapsed latency, and cold/warm separation are absent.

feature_gaps.title: Streaming model performance
feature_gaps.detail: **Missing; performance extension.** Application benchmarking records JSON responses, not streaming token events. TTFT, inter-token latency, output tokens/sec, and streaming completion integrity are unavailable. Assistant reply streaming is already implemented and is a separate capability.

feature_gaps.title: Segment/slice analysis
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Case predicates and independent grouping for comparisons exist. Reports lack general summaries by metadata segment, customer, language, difficulty, or model configuration.

feature_gaps.title: Dataset utilities and versioned suites
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Validation, candidate review/promotion, episodes, and content hashes exist. General schema-aware CSV/JSON/Parquet import, diff/dedup/split tools, and a named suite catalog are missing.

feature_gaps.title: Workspace maintenance and portability
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Migrations and an artifact GC library exist. CLI backup/restore, portable run/session bundles, workspace integrity/repair, retention/storage usage, and safe GC commands are missing. Absolute recorded paths complicate migration.

feature_gaps.title: Judge repeat/calibration workflow
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Statistical primitives, native calibration, and comparisons exist. A practical command that repeats/calibrates the configured model judges against reviewed labels is incomplete; F12 affects a helper branch.

feature_gaps.title: Platform and release confidence
feature_gaps.detail: **Partial.** Windows/Linux CI is configured; macOS CI is absent, current cross-platform results were not observed, and published support/readiness documents still center on older candidates.

feature_gaps.title: Advanced scale, load, and modality workflows
feature_gaps.detail: **Deferred.** Distributed workers, a scalable work queue, open-loop/ramping load profiles, multimodal evaluators, and a dashboard are product extensions. Ordinary concurrency and RPS quotas already exist.
